title: Obama shuts down a Putin back channel through Malmgren

tellings.quote: We discussed the fact that Putin was trying to set up a diplomatic back channel with Harold in 2009, but that Obama shut that prospect down.

plain: In 2009, the Russian leader Vladimir Putin is said to have tried to set up a private diplomatic channel through Harald Malmgren, a former adviser to American presidents, and President Barack Obama is said to have shut the idea down. Michels tells it as something he and Malmgren had talked about off camera. It suggests Malmgren was trusted at the highest levels long after leaving office.
